[SWS_Pwm_00184] ⌈This API initiates all actions needed to enable a HW module to
enter the target power state.
The possibility to operate the periphery depends on the power state and the HW fea-
tures. These properties should be known to the integrator and the decision whether to
use the periphery or not is in his responsibility.⌋
